title: Valley walk, zero vertical
terrain: flat valley floor or road, strictly no ascent and no descent
coachNotes: This was a rest day and physiologically it still is. It is written down at load 15 because a rest day in the mountains with nothing else to do is a rest day you will improvise on, and the improvised version has vertical in it. Forty minutes, flat, walking, no watch anxiety. The hard constraint is zero vertical in both directions: this day is contiguous with the Fri-Sun block and every metre of descent you take today comes out of Saturday's budget. If the only flat option is a road, take the road. Garmin target 20-30. The real session today is sleep: you are averaging 6h24 over the last seven days and Saturday is 3h40 above 2000m. Nap if you can.
